content.name: Anjali Kulkarni
content.title: Staff Nurse, Cardiac Care Unit
content.summary: B.Sc Nursing graduate registered with the Maharashtra Nursing Council, working as a staff nurse in a 16-bed cardiac care unit. Completed my internship in critical care and hold AHA BLS and ACLS, with strong patient counselling skills in Marathi, Hindi and English.

experience.title: Nursing Intern
bullets: Rotated through medical ICU, surgical wards, paediatrics and labour room under the supervision of nursing tutors and ward sisters.
Assisted in 40+ central line and urinary catheter insertions while maintaining aseptic technique audited by the infection control nurse.
Delivered 12 health education sessions on hypertension and diet to OPD patients and their families in Marathi and Hindi.

experience.title: Staff Nurse, Cardiac Care Unit
bullets: Monitor 3 patients per shift in a 16-bed CCU, including post-angioplasty, heart failure and post-CABG patients on inotropes.
Prepare patients for 25–30 cath lab procedures a week, completing checklists, femoral and radial site care and post-procedure monitoring.
Identified early ST changes in a post-PCI patient during a night shift and escalated promptly, leading to an emergency re-intervention.
Maintained 100% compliance in two NABH documentation audits for high-alert medication double checks.

education.details: CGPA 8.2/10. Internship included 6 weeks in critical care.

courses.name: Basic Life Support (BLS) and ACLS
courses.provider: American Heart Association, authorised training centre

achievements.title: Registered Nurse and Registered Midwife
achievements.detail: Registered with the Maharashtra Nursing Council, 2024.
